scope: Reset Cleared Status, Disable Blackboard, Payment Plan?, Non-Returning and Non-Returning Reason together for eligible Cleared student-term records without approved bills or audited manual exceptions.
sourceDocument: Spring 2027 Approve Your Bill Issues & Questions_-6.pdf
dependencies: Existing verified CF-033 environment baseline; no other newly prepared unit required.
notes: User authorized Fall 2026 as internal lower bound, blank values and no cutoff wording on screen. Existing chronological Term comparison is retained.

Physical fields and labels are validated against configuration before preview/write. Empty string is required for Non-Returning Reason: the live API rejects JSON null. Date resets to null, Cleared lookup to verified blank 0, checkboxes to false.

Eligibility still requires Cleared; Not Cleared, already-blank statuses and unrelated fields are preserved. No blanket repair of previous cleared-to-blank rows is performed. Such historical repair requires the prior audit and current-value review.
Policy version 3 invalidates old manual previews and prevents old enabled schedules from silently adopting broader writes. Explicit re-enabling starts after 15 minutes; defaults stay off.
Same-student/term current and qualifying legacy approvals, manual exceptions, shared lease, live double-check, exact readback and pre-write audit remain.
No automatic schedule was enabled. Reverting code does not restore fields already cleared; use recorded before snapshots under a reviewed data correction.
promotionNotes: Deployed on isolated environment-specific release branches. For later promotion/removal, select this unit and verify the current target release; preserve unrelated units, settings and assets.
removalNotes: Revert only this unit from the current target release. Preserve later/unrelated units and any stored historical records. Data side effects are not reversed by code removal.
